mapper.insert: INSERT INTO external_benchmark_values ( company_id, source_code, dataset_code, metric_code, base_year, industry_code, industry_name, original_value, original_unit, normalized_value, normalized_unit, source_updated_at, raw_payload, synced_at, sync_run_id ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{sourceCode}, #{datasetCode}, #{metricCode}, #{baseYear}, #{industryCode}, #{industryName}, #{originalValue}, #{originalUnit}, #{normalizedValue}, #{normalizedUnit}, #{sourceUpdatedAt}, CAST(#{rawPayload} AS JSONB), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{syncRunId} ) ON CONFLICT (company_id, source_code, metric_code, base_year, industry_code) DO UPDATE SET dataset_code = EXCLUDED.dataset_code, industry_name = EXCLUDED.industry_name, original_value = EXCLUDED.original_value, original_unit = EXCLUDED.original_unit, normalized_value = EXCLUDED.normalized_value, normalized_unit = EXCLUDED.normalized_unit, source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at, raw_payload = EXCLUDED.raw_payload, synced_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, sync_run_id = EXCLUDED.sync_run_id
mapper.select: SELECT id, company_id, base_year, industry_code, status, triggered_by, started_at, completed_at, error_message FROM external_benchmark_sync_runs WHERE company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY started_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(m.reporting_year) FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.status = 'APPROVED' AND i.indicator_code = 'IND_E_ELEC' AND m.shipment_amount_million_krw > 0

WITH active_facilities AS ( SELECT COUNT(*)::INT AS facility_count FROM company_facilities WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND is_active = TRUE ), matched AS ( SELECT electricity.period_value, COUNT(DISTINCT electricity.facility_id)::INT AS matched_count FROM esg_metric_data electricity JOIN esg_indicators electricity_indicator ON electricity_indicator.id = electricity.indicator_id AND electricity_indicator.indicator_code = 'IND_E_ELEC' JOIN esg_metric_data scope2 ON scope2.company_id = electricity.company_id AND scope2.facility_id = electricity.facility_id AND scope2.reporting_year = electricity.reporting_year AND scope2.period_type = electricity.period_type AND scope2.period_value = electricity.period_value AND scope2.status = 'APPROVED' JOIN esg_indicators scope_indicator ON scope_indicator.id = scope2.indicator_id AND scope_indicator.indicator_code = 'IND_E_SCOPE2' WHERE electricity.company_id = #{companyId} AND electricity.reporting_year = #{year} AND electricity.period_type = 'MONTHLY' AND electricity.status = 'APPROVED' AND electricity.shipment_amount_million_krw > 0 GROUP BY electricity.period_value ) SELECT MAX(matched.period_value) FROM matched CROSS JOIN active_facilities WHERE matched.matched_count = active_facilities.facility_count

WITH electricity AS ( SELECT m.facility_id, m.period_value, m.numerical_value, m.shipment_amount_million_krw FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.reporting_year = #{year} AND m.period_type = 'MONTHLY' AND m.period_value BETWEEN 1 AND #{throughMonth} AND m.status = 'APPROVED' AND i.indicator_code = 'IND_E_ELEC' AND m.shipment_amount_million_krw > 0 ), scope2 AS ( SELECT m.facility_id, m.period_value, m.numerical_value FROM esg_metric_data m JOIN esg_indicators i ON i.id = m.indicator_id WHERE m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.reporting_year = #{year} AND m.period_type = 'MONTHLY' AND m.period_value BETWEEN 1 AND #{throughMonth} AND m.status = 'APPROVED' AND i.indicator_code = 'IND_E_SCOPE2' ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(electricity.numerical_value) / 1000.0, 0) AS electricity_mwh, COALESCE(SUM(electricity.shipment_amount_million_krw) / 100.0, 0) AS shipment_hundred_million_krw, COALESCE(SUM(scope2.numerical_value), 0) AS scope2_tco2eq, COUNT(*)::INT AS matched_facility_months FROM electricity JOIN scope2 ON scope2.facility_id = electricity.facility_id AND scope2.period_value = electricity.period_value
